piece.caption: How to run Gemini Live voice updates on budget Android Go devices for your site staff. You do not need expensive smartphones for every field employee. Google has re-architected the Gemini app to run smoothly on lower-memory Android hardware. Your team can use Gemini Live to speak in over 45 languages or point the camera at paper notes and forms to translate them. Download the app from Google Play or hold the phone power button to launch it on supported models. Do your field workers prefer voice reporting over typing long texts?

piece.dm_text:
Here is how to set up Gemini on budget Android Go phones for your field staff:

1. Check if the device runs Android (Go edition).
2. Download the Gemini app directly from Google Play.
3. On supported devices, press and hold the power button to start.
4. Use Gemini Live to converse out loud in over 45 languages.
5. Point the camera at site forms or paper notes to translate them.

Source: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-app/gemini-lower-memory-devices/

[33] Google AI Blog — The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices.
URL: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-app/gemini-lower-memory-devices/
The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices. Angus Logan
For hundreds of millions of people globally, a lower-memory Android device is their everyday connection to the internet, education, and business.
Until recently, hardware limits meant those phones only had basic voice commands. Now, we’re bringing the Gemini app to eligible Android (Go edition) devices , putting Google’s personal AI assistant in the hands of hundreds of millions more people. We re-architected the app so the core Gemini experience runs smoothly on hardware with less memory.
Instead of typing out long prompts, you can talk things through or practice for an interview out loud in more than 45 languages with Gemini Live , point your camera at notes or forms to learn and translate, or create custom images with Nano Banana — like a flyer for a weekend bakery sale. To get started, download the Gemini app on Google Play, press and hold the power button on supported phones, or look for it preloaded on upcoming devices from partners like Transsion.
